guard: a managed Jcode seat whose private sessions directory exists but cannot be written is refused before any create_session reaches the harness, renders the fixed sessions_unwritable code with the path and the errno, and never dies as startup failed (unknown) - while an empty writable directory still starts, joins, and lists nothing
why: #1538: real jcode v0.81.5 accepts create_session on a sessions/ directory it cannot write
and dies only later, while persisting the session during the first turn, so the seat rendered
as `startup failed (unknown)` - a death outside every guard the connector owns. The connector
now asks the kernel the question the harness will actually face (W_OK on the directory), not
the question a readdir can answer: a readable-but-unwritable directory is the same defect as an
unreadable one, and a missing directory is a first launch that must stay untouched.
M1 is the shipped defect: the refusal removed entirely, so the harness is asked, accepts, and
the seat dies on the first turn - the cell that must go red first names the create_session
that reached the harness. M2 narrows the check to directories the connector can also read,
recreating the exact gap this lane closed (readdir succeeds, W_OK refuses, nothing stops the
launch). M3 makes the render lie by falling back to the scrubbed unknown diagnostic. M4 and
M5 attack the accept control from both sides: refusing a first launch with no directory yet,
and refusing the legitimately empty writable directory the panic-recovery path exists to serve.

mutations.name: M1 the shipped defect: ask the harness anyway, never refuse
mutations.find:
const unwritable = unwritableStoredSessions(stored);
    if (unwritable) throw new JcodeSessionsUnwritableFailure(unwritable.path, unwritable.code);
mutations.expectRed: the unwritable sessions directory never reaches the harness

mutations.name: M2 check only directories the connector can read (the readdir-only gap)
mutations.expectRed: the unwritable sessions directory never reaches the harness

mutations.name: M3 render the refusal as the scrubbed unknown diagnostic
mutations.expectRed: the refusal names sessions_unwritable, the path, and EACCES

mutations.name: M4 refuse a first launch whose sessions directory does not exist yet
mutations.expectRed: the unwritable sessions directory never reaches the harness

mutations.name: M5 refuse the legitimately empty writable directory
mutations.find:

    if (unwritable) throw new JcodeSessionsUnwritableFailure(unwritable.path, unwritable.code);
mutations.replace:

    if (unwritable) throw new JcodeSessionsUnwritableFailure(unwritable.path, unwritable.code);
